standard-dialogue-talking-to-head-guard-.npc: This area is restricted. Leave now!

standard-dialogue-while-wearing-khazard-.npc: Er... yes... quite right. Did you need something?

standard-dialogue-while-wearing-khazard-.player: Just checking if you have any orders for me.

standard-dialogue-while-wearing-khazard-.npc: Not right now. Things are all very boring at the moment. What I'd give to be over at the bar having a nice Khali brew...

standard-dialogue-while-wearing-khazard-.player: Khali brew? Can't say I've ever had one.

standard-dialogue-while-wearing-khazard-.npc: Oh, nothing beats them! Mind you, don't make the mistake of having too many. Last time I did, I ended up falling straight to sleep.

standard-dialogue-talking-to-head-guard-.npc: What a boring day. You'd think the slaves would be more entertaining.

standard-dialogue-talking-to-head-guard-.player: Not long now until you get a break though, right?

standard-dialogue-talking-to-head-guard-.npc: Too right! Then it's straight to the bar for a nice Khali brew.

standard-dialogue-after-getting-khali-br.npc: What a boring day. You'd think the slaves would be more entertaining.

standard-dialogue-after-getting-khali-br.player: Do you still fancy a drink?

standard-dialogue-after-getting-khali-br.npc: Oh... okay then, but just the one.

standard-dialogue-after-getting-khali-br.text: You hand a bottle of Khali brew to the Head Guard and he quickly drinks it all.

standard-dialogue-after-getting-khali-br.npc: That is some gooood stuff... yeah... wooh, yeah!
Yeesshh! Oooh, maybe I sshould relax for a while.

standard-dialogue-after-getting-khali-br.player: Good idea. I'll look after the prisoners.

standard-dialogue-after-getting-khali-br.npc: Yeesh... that shounds reasonable. Here, take the keysch. Any trouble, you give... you give 'em a good beating.

standard-dialogue-after-getting-khali-br.text: The Head Guard gives you some keys.

standard-dialogue-after-getting-khali-br.player: Don't worry, I'll keep them in line

standard-dialogue-talking-to-head-guard-.npc: Pleash... leave me alone. Did the walls always shway soooo much?
Thish areash resh... restricted! We don't like strangersh... 'specially ones who sway. Oooh!

standard-dialogue-after-losing-the-set-o.player: Hi, er... I lost the keys.

standard-dialogue-after-losing-the-set-o.npc: What? You're foolish... and I'm all drunk. Here... takes my shpare shh... set!

standard-dialogue-after-losing-the-set-o.text: The Head Guard gives you some keys.
